description: Labeled request examples for the QFM-Agent routing probe. Twelve requests per task: the first half of each task's requests forms the classical-baseline training split, the second half is the shared evaluation split. Version 3 expands the v2 four-per-task probe and keeps its items inside their original halves as a reproducible subset.
